title: control / privacy.export_ready (v1) data payload
description: The assembled data-export bundle is ready. Published by the Control Room (privacy aggregator) to the 'control.events' exchange with routing key 'privacy.export_ready'; consumed by Mailing to deliver the export to the data subject. (ADR-0009.)

userId.description: The data subject the export belongs to.

documentRef.description: Reference to the assembled export bundle (e.g. a stored file/archive id).

at.description: When the bundle was assembled (RFC3339 UTC).
